title: Rabbi Chasa
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Ruth Rabbah 5:4 mentions him on “May the Lord reward your deed, and may your reward be complete”: Rabbi Chasa says, “Because you came to take refuge.” Hyman endorses Maharzu’s proposed reading: “Rabbi Chasa said: Solomon will be your reward”—King Solomon will descend from you because you came to take refuge, etc. Hyman considers this to remove the difficulties raised about Rabbi Chasa’s statement.

notes.text: The matching complete paragraph is Ruth Rabbah 5:4. Maharzu’s proposed reading turns complete, shelemah, into the name Solomon, Shelomoh; Hyman endorses that wordplay as resolving earlier objections.
The ordinary Ruth Rabbah 5:4 text was inspected. Maharzu’s exact commentary was not independently inspected here; the proposed Solomon reading and its endorsement remain attributed to Hyman.
